scope: Observed reciprocal trailing FPM attribute/edge cache, geometry-ordinal journal mentions and same-asset positive literal/native descriptor numeric correspondence; historical state and exact selected-source identity unresolved

interfaces.dependencies: decode_asm_history supplies explicit geometry ordinals/journal slots. materialize_asm_alternative supplies a separately qualified slot0/side0 cache view and origin map. decode_asm_generic_tags opt-in FPM framing preserves its strict default.
interfaces.expected_outputs: samples[].expected_summary and controls[].expected_summary contain complete native-tracking outputs
interfaces.integration: Separate FPM tracking summary only. Keep exact_selected_source_identity, qualified_historical_state and source_curve_geometry null. Nested alternative_view_correspondence qualifies recipe/FPM agreement only within the explicit alternate cache view. Preserve all initial-cache/secondary-context/tool failures.

grammar.FPM_attribute: Exactly8 typed tokens: pointer-1,integer-1,nextattribute pointer,previousattribute pointer,edge-owner pointer,string FPM_tracked_attrib_def,integer1,positive uint32-range integer literal. Full byte payload replays exactly.
grammar.owner: Geometry ordinal namespace spans initial+trailing entity records, excluding all markers/history records. Attribute owner pointer and owner first-attribute/next/previous chain are reciprocal. Observed edge/vertex/point/straight-curve cache signatures are typed and finite; first-coedge refers back to the owner edge.
grammar.journal: Only literal table mentions and sides0/1 are exposed from the shared bounded parser. Chronological transition-side interpretation is not assigned.
grammar.native_correspondence: An equal positive literal must identify one actual native topology descriptor with a framed edge recipe, feature owner, reciprocal support, historical anchor and native BODY mapped explicitly to typed initial ASM BODY in this same asset blob. The literal itself is not represented as a serialized typed native reference.
grammar.qualified_alternative: Only independently qualified slot0/side0 alternate view is admitted. Explicit pair alias connects the native mapped BODY to the viewed BODY. Exact generic-tag name tuples select one reciprocal edge and ordered endpoint vertices; that edge must also be the explicitly origin-mapped FPM attribute owner. No coordinates or root ordinals select the candidate.

limitations: The alternate-view materializer has a narrow captured three-state schema; it is not universal history replay and its slot0/side0 view is not labeled chronologically before/after/current/final.
Even when recipe and FPM agree uniquely within that view, general exact historical selected-source identity remains unclaimed. Numeric FPM/descriptor equality alone cannot establish it.

The original initial-cache edge association failures remain meaningful: Chamfer removes the selected edge and Fillet caches can include unsupported topology. A successful alternate-view candidate does not clear those failures.

Actual selected edge geometry getters were not captured in these old EdgeMode fixtures. API settings/edge-set counts and generator seed shape corroborate scope, not persistent identity. All geometry here is explicitly stored cache geometry.

Only observed trailing Line-owner FPM attributes and Fillet/Chamfer276-byte single-cache descriptors with116-byte edge recipes are admitted; circles, faces, other custom definitions and other native owner families remain unsupported.
